question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aa8ce36714b715c1fec6b5c286cd7cb6df89c54cfe4d58be69fdc9908ff4ee8.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) **For '** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47be7bad044c637bd449ee9e595717e4d5a98cd1d2ea915ec92f226b7109fbf0.png] **' element **:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ab2c441768724af1278671148d43a4571470b4759fc7c8290ec5bc09b5900a8.png] 

 
• Each ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47be7bad044c637bd449ee9e595717e4d5a98cd1d2ea915ec92f226b7109fbf0.png] ' element is shifting one and two places in the clockwise direction subsequently.
 
• Each ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47be7bad044c637bd449ee9e595717e4d5a98cd1d2ea915ec92f226b7109fbf0.png] ' element is rotating 90º clockwise direction subsequently.

​Similarly, all arrows follow the same rules. 

**Thus, final series is :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cef6e44059eb91588d78fbf92a91ac2533f0bf48431ee44a5d5d6433ec5e6d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".
